period_initialization: Independent flat accounts; actual common executable boundaries must be established by P0; segments are not statistically independent

capital_semantics.stocks: Native normalized accounts scale linearly by 1000000. Preserve MAIN/CHINEXT 50/50 internal starting budgets and fractional native units; do not silently replace with exchange lots.
capital_semantics.SMV6: Native local cash account starts at 1000000 with 100-share lots.
capital_semantics.qualification: 4000000 is a native-semantics research denomination, not proof of exchange-executable fractional stock quantities. P0 reconciliation is required before any physical-account replay.

gap_exclusivity: Exactly one of OGR or IFCGR
confirmation: Exact ATRDR-Bull/MCB economic identity only: matching nonempty parent_event_id, or all of symbol, direction, completed decision timestamp, legal entry session and underlying economic event definition. ATRDR lot/size/priority/native exit retained. MCB-only events execute. No proximity matching.
physical_account: One cash, aggregate physical positions, one NAV and one fee ledger; cash >= 0 and gross <= NAV at every checkpoint; no margin, clipping or retrospective scaling
virtual_lots: Attribute strategy, route, family, event_id, parent_event_id, virtual_lot_id, symbol, quantity, funding_type, requested/funded notional, entry/exit, fees, realized/unrealized P&L and capital-days. Sum quantities equals physical positions. Attributed equity plus unallocated physical cash equals physical NAV. Virtual lots create no additional cash.
home_budget: Parallel independent P0 native NAV at the same legal checkpoint, starting at 1000000 each; counterfactual budget reference only, never a signal or holding-state reference; shared P&L never enlarges entitlement
base_priority: All base demands before shared allocation; native priority within strategy; cross-strategy deterministic tie-break; record insufficient base funding without forced liquidation
shared_pool: Remaining legally available physical cash; proportional to each strategy's eligible unmet native notional, native priority within strategy, native lots, largest-remainder redistribution
native_size: 0 <= funded_notional <= native_requested_notional; no enlargement of a fully funded intent; actual funded holdings and execution history drive all subsequent native decisions
P0: Four independently funded native sleeves; no shared funding
P1: Native constraints only, no additional caps/gate; diagnostic only, ineligible for final preference

P2.market_drift: Do not sell existing positions; prohibit additional entry risk while the relevant cap is breached

P3.dd_source: Previous completed trading-day close NAV / running high - 1
P3.loosening: One level after 3 consecutive completed days at least 0.10D inside the next looser threshold; reset counter on transition
P3.scope: New-entry funding capacity only, never existing positions; D is not guaranteed MDD; report overshoot

execution_order: legal native intents from actual strategy state

stocks.model: Native composite execution costs, charged once

candidate_criteria.strong: Both periods: exposure and funded opportunity rate increase; CAGR >= P0; MaxDD <= P0; shared-funded P&L >= 0; no material base starvation
candidate_criteria.conditional: Both periods utilization increases and MaxDD <= P0 + 0.50pp; interpretable economics, no severe starvation/date anomalies; modest CAGR degradation in at most one segment
candidate_criteria.reject: Risk-budget breach, material shared-funded losses, frequent base displacement, anomalous-date dependence, one materially failed segment, mere Demand duplication, or gate return loss without meaningful tail improvement
candidate_criteria.qualitative_terms: Material/modest/severe and anomalous concentration are not numerically specified by the request. Report underlying amounts and frequencies; do not silently convert them to tuned numerical thresholds or an automatic candidate pass.

outcome_gate: P0 opportunities, funded trades, positions, cash, fees, sleeve NAV and combined NAV must reconcile to independent native accounts at accepted deterministic tolerances; otherwise fail closed.
